Despite a rocky launch the Remastered version of The Witcher 3 is gradually improving with each patch on PS5 and Xbox - taking us up to update 5.01. Compared to the initial 5.00 version frame-rates are improved, particularly on both PlayStation consoles. Elsewhere, Tom takes a look at the broader visual upgrades in the remaster, alongside the Pro enhancements. NOTE: Hotfix 5.01b has landed since this video's creation, which CDPR promises to bring "various stability improvements to help ensure a more reliable experience while witchering across the Continent."
